title: Modern Horizons 3 Promos: card flavor text

paragraphs.text: "I call upon a power greater than myself."
His oath required no service beyond death, but his honor demanded it.
Even the weather of Dominaria shifts to assail would-be invaders.
"I see where you're going with that, and I don't like it."
The rising moon calls mercilessly to the waves, commanding the sea to rise high enough to devour mountains.
Live fully, then return to the beginning.
Some birds sing to nature's beauty and the freedom of the skies. Others simply ask questions.
"Suffer as I have suffered. Lose as I have lost."
As the monster lay dying, it stared into the eyes of the human who slew it. Decades later, it has yet to break its gaze.
"The living take their souls for granted. The dead know what they're worth."
"Decent. But let me show you what mastery looks like."
For every action, a reaction. For every force, a firestorm.
The wheel only has one sure output: chaos.
"You need to expand your horizons."
When Gaea speaks, all of nature falls silent.
"Kozilek experiences reality on his own terms." —Ayli, high priest of the Eternal Pilgrims
"Skreeg! I thought I told you to stop messing with... Oh, that worked. Good job, Skreeg." —Ral Zarek
Born from the greatest granite boulder, nursed on the sweetest honey, crowned amid a raging blizzard.
Some frogs poison the body. Some frogs poison the mind.
Her new demonic overlords prized her knowledge of Bant's landscape.
"The sun and moon have decided to make a competition of our misery." —Naromin, veteran explorer
A graveyard for conquerors and conquered alike.
Once a prosperous Vantress town, now swept clean and reclaimed by the waters of the wilds.
A warped gateway that seeps toxins and malevolence into the waters around Towashi.
An underground paradise, bright and thriving beneath the surface of Ixalan.
Home and hunting ground for Kaldheim's fearsome trolls.
His pride denied him; his brother did not.
"Our recruitment drives are bringing in fewer fresh troops every day. We need a new strategy." —Urza, to Tawnos
